mathematical_results.statement: For M=[[d,g^T],[g,C]], d!=0, S=C-d^{-1}gg^T, one has q=d(s+d^{-1}g^Ty)^2+y^TSy and det M=d det S. Thus three large eigenvalues imply |det S|>=1/|d|.

Independent cap-one hub plus bounded L marginal plus uniform mu_l(E)<=K|E|^{1/2} does not suffice for Q=dX^2+2XL+Y. Explicit X,U,Z uniforms have K=2 yet a(X+U/a)^2-Z^2 has logarithmically unbounded density; the matrix has a zero eigenvalue, so QFORM itself is not refuted.

partner_result_applied.application: For Q_eta=aX^2+2XU+(a^{-1}+eta)U^2-Z^2, ||p||inf<=31|a eta|^{-1/6}. At a=1, eta=-2, spectrum={sqrt(2),-sqrt(2),-1} and ||p||inf<27.618.

unresolved_implication.statement: For the exact heavy-row form d(sqrt(c)X_0+C)^2+y^TSy with |det S|>=1/|d|, prove a universal interval/density bound while retaining that (C,y) are simultaneous linear forms of the original independent residual coordinates. Spend determinant curvature before any slice-only relaxation.
